# OpenSpace User Meeting
_August 26 – August 28, 2026_

Join us for the second in-person user meeting in beautiful Norrköping, Sweden. OpenSpace users of all levels are invited to the Visualization Center C for three days of trainings, presentations, hands-on sessions, and networking. This is a great opportunity to:

  - Sharpen your OpenSpace skills
  - Explore the latest software features and updates
  - Connect with educators, planetarium professionals, researchers, and developers in the OpenSapce community

The [registration](https://visualiseringscenter.se/registration-openspace-user-meeting/) is **free**. We recommend to bring your own OpenSpace-compatible laptop for meeting as loaner devices are limited.

Please contact [Alexander Bock](alexander.bock@liu.se) for any information about the meeting.
